en.headline: RCEP sets up accession working group for Hong Kong
en.dek: The regional trade pact approved an Accession Working Group on Monday, starting formal entry talks for Hong Kong along with Bangladesh, Chile and Sri Lanka.
body: The Hong Kong government welcomed a decision by the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership to establish an Accession Working Group and begin the formal accession process for several applicant economies, including Hong Kong.

Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau described the move as a pivotal step in enlarging RCEP membership. He said Hong Kong would actively take part in the working group’s work and related negotiations with existing members, aiming to complete the required procedures as soon as possible.

Yau noted that Hong Kong is fully ready for early accession and will leverage its strengths to contribute to the pact and promote regional economic integration. He thanked the Central People’s Government, including the Ministry of Commerce, for its enduring support, and expressed appreciation to RCEP members, particularly ASEAN, for backing the establishment of the group.

Bangladesh, Chile and Sri Lanka were also admitted to the Accession Working Group. RCEP currently comprises 15 member economies: the Chinese mainland, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand and the ten ASEAN countries.

zh.headline: RCEP成立加入工作組 啟動香港加入程序
zh.dek: 區域全面經濟夥伴關係協定周一通過成立加入工作組，正式展開包括香港在內多個申請經濟體的加入程序。
body: 特區政府歡迎《區域全面經濟夥伴關係協定》（RCEP）通過成立「加入工作組」，啟動包括香港在內各申請經濟體的加入程序。
商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺表示，有關決定是協定吸納新成員進程中關鍵的一步。香港將積極配合及參與工作組的工作，包括與協定成員進行相關加入談判，以期盡快完成所有所需程序。
丘應樺指出，香港已做好充分準備盡早加入協定，發揮優勢為協定和促進區域經濟融合作出貢獻，同時有助鞏固香港作為國際貿易中心的地位。他特別感謝中央人民政府包括商務部一直大力支持，並向包括東盟在內的協定成員就支持成立工作組表示感謝。
其他納入加入工作組的申請經濟體包括孟加拉、智利及斯里蘭卡。RCEP現有15個成員經濟體，包括中國內地、日本、韓國、澳洲、新西蘭及東盟十國。
